scope: One CI-only live owner/journal module. No production or ordinary runner admission. No Windows API, import, test, build, policy, profile, network, Native, Git or CI execution by this authoring task.

interface.source_pins: 6–16 canonical absolute paths to frozen raw SHA256, including this module/readiness/C/runner/launch and DLL; root plans11 entries. Held through shared preserved() for lifetime.
interface.witness: Independent stable JSON witness (not AppContainer.check_contract); rechecked before/after each lifecycle operation together with own actual DLL/source raw hashes.
interface.profile_name: Fresh exclusive name reservation completes before constructor returns and before caller CreateAppContainerProfile.
interface.prepare: prepare(actual_sid_bytes): exact40-byte actual SID, live C owner, permanent exclusive SID and5GUID tombstones, PREPARED flushed before any Arm.
interface.bind_context: bind_context({'base': base_contract, 'scope_ids': scope_ids}): full sealed source/DLL/scope/profile/tool/helper contract in exclusive flushed context file before arm.
interface.cleanup_authorized: Live bool property only after PG_RemoveWhenEmpty success, exact C removed/no-policy state, durable REMOVED and final live freshness. False once poisoned/unknown/abandoned; never read from receipt.
interface.abandon: Idempotent local disposal only. C frees owned local resources and closes non-dynamic engine; no policy/profile/state deletion, reuse, adoption or cleanup retry. Receipt remains available after disposal.

host_state.root: RUNNER_TEMP/kicad-autorouter-persistent-guard011-state; outside fresh direct kicad-appcontainer007-<UUID> granted scope
host_state.acl: Created with protected explicit SYSTEM+Administrators FILE_ALL_ACCESS only; root OI|CI, files no inheritance. Actual TokenOwner SID, exact2ACEs, masks, protection, noninheritable handles, canonical final handle paths and file IDs checked. No privilege enabling or DACL repair fallback.
host_state.reservation: Exclusive host .lock plus at most16 permanent slot/name/SID/key/context reservations; CREATE_NEW tombstones, collisions refuse. Existing content is never authority and never removed.
host_state.durability: Every complete file/append uses WriteFile full-size check then FlushFileBuffers; retained handle identity/size, exact bytes and protected DACL replay. Partial writes/flush errors poison and remain retained; no truncate/repair. No power-loss/storage durability claim.
host_state.crash_semantics: No state-load/recover/adopt/remove API. Pending-create/C-handle state stays live only; a crashed owner cannot use serialized SID/keys/zero/PIDs to remove, restore ACL or delete profile. Tombstones remain permanent for runner lifetime.

safety_order: Caller reserves constructor profile_name before CreateProfile; caller passes returned actualSID to prepare.
Caller seals own tool tree then binds base+scope identities, then arm; no child before arming.
Register actual Job, begin_create immediately before each fallible CreateProcess, register actual suspended process immediately after creation, verify token/contracts and before_resume last.
Any external creation/registration/token/assignment/resume/contract/cleanup uncertainty calls poison. Wrong-thread use immediately revokes Python authority; C disposal requires creator thread.
Normal cleanup only creator-thread live sealed C owner with its retained actual handles and exact policy absence. Caller requires cleanup_authorized before original ACL/profile cleanup.
Abandon never grants cleanup and never deletes policy/profile/state; all close/flush/free errors visible.
